result.summary: The image depicts an institutional setting with a signalized intersection and well-maintained sidewalks. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like lighting and signage is present, the lack of high-visibility crosswalk markings at the crossing point reduces the overall safety level.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalk
hazards.description: The intersection lacks clearly painted crosswalk markings, which may lead to drivers failing to anticipate pedestrians crossing the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway at the intersection corner

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian path and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: The street features a well-maintained sidewalk and mature trees that provide a pleasant pedestrian buffer. However, the lack of marked crosswalks or traffic control at the visible junction increases exposure for pedestrians crossing the two-lane roadway.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, which fails to alert drivers to pedestrian crossing points.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Large street trees and a stone wall may partially obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway along the sidewalk

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian path and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Add warning signs to alert drivers to the potential presence of pedestrians at the crossing point.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks, curb ramps with tactile warning surfaces, and dedicated pedestrian signals. The environment is well-maintained with wide sidewalks, though a traffic signal pole is situated within the pedestrian path.

hazards.name: Pole in Pedestrian Path
hazards.description: A traffic signal pole is located within the sidewalk area near the curb ramp, which could pose a minor obstacle for people with mobility or visual impairments.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground on the sidewalk near the tactile paving.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility to turning motorists.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to provide a 3-7 second head start for pedestrians before the parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps with tactile warning strips. The environment is well-maintained with clear sidewalks and street lighting, though it lacks physical traffic calming measures like medians or curb extensions.

hazards.name: Wide turning radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively high-speed right turns from the cross-street into the main road.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross the entire roadway width without a refuge island or median.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle green light.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to slow approaching traffic and increase pedestrian visibility.
